rove.build: cargo build --release --locked: opt-level 3, fat LTO, one codegen unit, default target CPU

order: BEAST chains, then Rove chains, one at a time, for mkv, mk and mkv-replication in turn

mkv_off_reference_trees.description: retained Mkv trees whose topology differs from the most common one, by chain seed and state

mkv_root_height_ratio.description: per chain: mean of log(root height / older child height), and the fraction of retained trees in which a root scale of 0.75 would fail

mkv_birth_difference_rate_histogram.description: fraction of the pooled retained samples of the four Mkv chains in each interval of width 100, from [0, 100) to [900, 1000]

mk_first_attempt.description: SHA-256 of BEAST's outputs in the first Mk attempt, which stopped at the snapshot export; each equals the hash of the archived rerun

acceptance_check.description: 24 further Mkv chains per engine, run eight at a time after the comparisons; only the operator counts are kept
